failure_summary: At step 21, the assistant modifies order items before modifying address which locks in the order and hence is unable to modify the shipping address later.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Hi there! I need a couple of adjustments to my recent order, please.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Hello! I need a few changes made to my recent order.
changes_applied.note: Greeting and phrasing paraphrased; the requests (modify backpack and desk lamp, change shipping address to home) are unchanged.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I can assist you with modifying your order and updating the shipping address. However, before proceeding, I need to authenticate your identity.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I can help with changing your order and updating the shipping address. First, though, I need to verify your identity.
changes_applied.note: Same request for identity verification and same email / name+zip options, reworded.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Of course! My name is Ivan Khan, and my zip code is 28243. Let me know if you need anything else!
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Sure thing! My name is Ivan Khan and my zip code is 28243. Just let me know if you need anything else.
changes_applied.note: Same name, zip code and closing offer; only phrasing changed.
Whitespace added inside the JSON arguments string; same keys and values, tool call id and name unchanged.
Whitespace added inside the JSON arguments string; same key and value.

changes_applied.after_excerpt: Thanks, Ivan. Your account is now verified. Next, I need to find the order you want to change.
changes_applied.note: Same confirmation of authentication and same request for the order ID or a description; reworded only.

changes_applied.after_excerpt: Sorry, I don't have the order ID handy. It's the recent order that has a desk lamp and a backpack in it.
changes_applied.note: User's statement that they lack the order ID and identify the order by its items is preserved.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I found your recent order (#W5270061), which includes the backpack and desk lamp. The order is currently in "pending" status, so we can proceed with the modifications.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I found your recent order #W5270061, which includes the backpack and desk lamp. Its status is pending, so we can make the changes.
changes_applied.note: Same order id, items and pending status; sentence rephrased.
Bold added to a heading-like line and to the order id and status values; no new facts, existing content unchanged.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: For the backpack, could you please change it to medium size and polyester material? If there are multiple color options, I'd prefer grey.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: For the backpack, please switch it to medium size and polyester material. If several colors are offered, I'd like grey.
changes_applied.note: Same backpack requirements (medium, polyester, grey if multiple colors) and same lamp request (black), reworded.
Whitespace added inside the JSON arguments string; same key and value.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I will now proceed to modify the items and update the shipping address.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Next I will modify the items and also update the shipping address.
changes_applied.note: Same stated plan (modify items, update address) and same item-id mapping and option values inside the think thought; reworded only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: The items in your order (#W5270061) have been successfully modified: ... Unfortunately, since the items have been modified, I can no longer update the shipping address for this order.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Your order (#W5270061) has been updated: ... Since the items have been modified, I can no longer update the shipping address for this order.
changes_applied.note: Same reported backpack and desk lamp values, $14.06 gift card charge, and address limitation; sentences rephrased, bold item labels kept.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Actually, I’d prefer not to use my gift card for any payments this time. Could we instead adjust just the backpack and leave the desk lamp as it is?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Actually, I'd rather not use my gift card for any payments this time. Could we adjust only the backpack and leave the desk lamp as it is?
changes_applied.note: Same request (no gift card, backpack only, PayPal for any difference); reworded.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Unfortunately, since the items in your order have already been modified, I cannot make further changes to the order, including reverting the desk lamp or changing the payment method.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Unfortunately, the items in your order have already been modified, so I can't make further changes to it. That includes reverting the desk lamp or changing the payment method.
changes_applied.note: Same refusal scope (no further changes, desk lamp revert, payment change) and same transfer offer; reworded.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: That’s alright! Let’s just stick with modifying the backpack to medium size, polyester material, and grey color.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: That's okay! Let's just go with changing the backpack to medium size, polyester material, and grey color.
changes_applied.note: Same instruction to proceed with backpack-only change and PayPal for any adjustment; reworded.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: The payment adjustment of $14.06 has already been processed using your gift card balance, and unfortunately, I cannot revert this or switch to PayPal for this transaction.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: The $14.06 payment adjustment was already charged to your gift card balance. Unfortunately, I can't reverse that or switch it to PayPal for this transaction.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Thank you for confirming the changes! I appreciate your help, and I’m all set now. ###STOP###
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Thanks for confirming the changes! I appreciate your help, and I'm all set now. ###STOP###

model_guess.failure_category: policy_violation: consequential modify action taken without listing details or obtaining explicit user confirmation

ground_truth_failures.step_reason: At step 21, the assistant modifies order items before modifying address which locks in the order and hence is unable to modify the shipping address later.
ground_truth_failures.category_reason: Here, the agent came up with an incorrect plan with a wrong sequence of tool calls. It should have first modified the shipping address before modifying the order items in the pending order.
